visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair, wearing a brown oversized blazer and a black and white patterned beanie, poses in front of a large blue wall. The wall has a white 'Jellycat Space London' logo and a cat graphic. She holds a small green ticket or card and smiles brightly at the camera. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a store designed like a spaceship. The woman walks through a corridor with bright orange pipes on the ceiling and glowing red wall panels. Other shoppers, including a man in a black vest and sunglasses, walk nearby. (3) Close-up shots show plush toys displayed in cylindrical glass cases with futuristic lighting. One case holds a gray UFO plush, and another holds a cat-headed plush in an astronaut suit. The woman interacts with a touchscreen displaying plush characters. (4) At a white counter, the woman interacts with a staff member wearing an orange jumpsuit and a white lab coat. They perform a 'scanning' ritual on a plush toy using a small silver tool. The woman gives a thumbs-up to the camera while smiling. (5) The woman and the man pose outside the building with large mascots, including a giant peanut wearing a purple cowboy hat. A long line of people is visible behind a barrier. The woman carries several light blue shopping bags with the store logo.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Jellycat在首爾開快閃店了!. [Logo]: Jellycat Space London. (2) [Subtitle]: 太空系列限定新品. (3) [Subtitle]: 也太可愛了吧. (4) [Subtitle]: 聖水洞最新熱門的 Jellycat Space. (5) [Subtitle]: 是全球首間以宇宙為主題打造的沉浸式快閃店. (6) [Subtitle]: 必須說體驗感真的是給很足. (7) [Subtitle]: 你走進去的時候結合聲光投影. (8) [Subtitle]: 就很像置身在太空艙的內部. (9) [Subtitle]: 我還以為我在哪個遊樂園哩. (10) [Subtitle]: 這裡有很多限定款. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個好可愛. (12) [Subtitle]: 有經典的兔兔. (13) [Subtitle]: 還有我想買的牛仔花生. (14) [Subtitle]: 每款都只能限購兩件. (15) [Subtitle]: 我真的選擇困難. (16) [Subtitle]: 後來忍不住買一堆. (17) [Subtitle]: 買禮盒的話還能現場情境體驗. (18) [Subtitle]: 情緒價值真的是給好給滿. [Variety]: (被迫要跟著演出的P哥😂). (19) [Subtitle]: 買完記得跟巨大Jellycat合照. (20) [Subtitle]: 雖然要排隊. (21) [Subtitle]: 但我們大概十幾分鐘就入場了. (22) [Subtitle]: 也可以在Naver平台預約. (23) [Subtitle]: 趕快分享給喜歡Jellycat的朋友們吧.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main character, 1 male companion, at least 3 staff members, and several other shoppers/pedestrians in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with dark hair wearing a brown oversized blazer, a black turtleneck, and a knit beanie. She is also seen wearing a white and black patterned beanie in some scenes.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior is a high-concept retail space themed after a spaceship (Jellycat Space). It features orange pipes, neon-lit corridors, futuristic glass display tubes, and digital screens. The exterior shows a modern urban street in Seoul with a large light-blue pop-up shop facade.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Enthusiastic female narration starts over a high-tempo, bright electronic pop background track. The voice is high-pitched and cheery, describing the excitement of the new store. (2) A mechanical 'ding' or digital interface sound occurs as the visual shows the interactive screen. The BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic pulse. (3) Subtle background store noise, such as muffled chatter and laughter, is layered underneath the voiceover as the woman explores the interior. (4) A distinctive 'whirring' and 'clicking' sound effect coincides with the staff member 'scanning' the plush toy. The narrator's tone remains high-arousal and celebratory. (5) The music continues at a consistent volume until a sharp fade-out as the woman gives a final sign-off, accompanied by faint outdoor street ambience.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Location Hook -> Interior Exploration -> Product Highlight -> Checkout Experience -> Logistics/Booking Info.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional lifestyle vlog to showcase the immersive 'Jellycat Space' pop-up store in Seoul. By highlighting the futuristic spaceship theme, limited edition products, and unique interactive purchasing experience, it aims to drive foot traffic and social media engagement for the brand.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcasing of store features, products, and purchase process, coupled with CTA to share with friends and booking information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high editing density and vibrant color grading typical of social-media travel/shopping vlogs. The 'spaceship' theme is effectively conveyed through both set design and post-production sound effects.
